# Confirm deleted entries stop being recoverable after the undo window

## What & Why
The current browser coverage verifies that Undo restores answers and applications, but not that the short-lived action disappears and the deletion remains after the recovery window expires.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage verifies the answer undo notice expires
- Browser coverage verifies the application undo notice expires
- Reloading after expiry confirms the deleted entry is still absent
